first.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: first endpoint frame of a collectible chameleon card.
Input image 1 is the EXACT SCENE AND CARD TEMPLATE. Preserve its camera, card size/position/aspect, all four corners, thin antique-gold ornamental border, parchment cream face, stone wall, moss, blue-gray workbench, lighting and framing exactly.
Replace ONLY the crab illustration inside the card. Remove the crab entirely. Paint one muted-sage chameleon, full body, expressive dark eye, gently curled spiral tail, subtle olive and cream shading, holding exactly ONE small wooden paintbrush with ochre bristles in one forefoot. Selected detailed pixel illustration style comes from input image 2 (style reference only); input image 3 supplies the chameleon-with-brush motif only, not its chunky block rendering.
Chameleon sits in the lower-middle of the cream card face, body slightly left of center, facing right, with curled tail comfortably contained to its left/below. Its free feet rest naturally on the illustrated ground. The brush extends slightly right, its tip hovering above a small completely BLANK region of parchment INSIDE the card near the creature. No stroke has been painted yet. Leave space for one loose curved brushstroke within the card to the right of/below the brush. Entire creature including tail and brush stays comfortably inside the gold border. No brush must touch or cross the border.
No paint jar, palette, extra brushes, clothing, other creatures or extra objects. Parchment is otherwise blank. No writing, text, digits, runes, diagrams, geometric constructions, symbols, sparkle, effects, UI or watermark. Quiet focused curiosity, no celebration. Opaque landscape16:9 PNG, match template dimensions exactly.

last.prompt:

Correct ONLY the ochre brushstroke in this exact frame. The brush tip currently rests in the middle of the stroke. It must rest at the END.

Preserve the chameleon, its face/body/tail, its single brush and forefoot pose, the card/border and their positions, all lighting, camera, workbench and mossy stone backdrop, pixel style, image dimensions and opacity. Do not introduce any other marks, letters, text, digits, runes, shapes, diagrams, objects, effects or sparkle. Make only this local correction.

draft.reason: The first final-pose generation placed the brush midway along the mark; a built-in edit removed the mark beyond its tip so the brush rests at the end of one loose curve.
